title: Reduce complete H4 replay time by 45.2% (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Exact projective-normal reuse reduces complete H4 replay median wall time from **2.462 s to 1.350 s**, **45.2% less**, in five alternating fresh-process pairs. All ten outputs are byte-identical, with zero errors.

```text
each spanning triple
  compute its original cofactor normal and check annihilation
  form an exact Q(sqrt(5)) projective key
  first occurrence: scan all sixty roots and retain the original normal
  later occurrence: reuse the established projective class
continue the unchanged complete verifier
```

Claim type: measured verifier improvement with a scoped implementation-equivalence proof and finite conformance evidence. No new mathematical bound or kappa is claimed. Only `research/h4-projective-normal-cache/` is added; the predecessor and selected frontier remain unchanged.

[Package and proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/4fdb25a3759fcb86cc92642d97a2a206771a8dfb/research/h4-projective-normal-cache) · [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19272415)

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml retains PR1867's H4 theorem, geometry, witness search, complete checks and credited predecessors. Classical quadratic-field conjugation and primitive integer normalization remain background. The new result is the reuse implementation and its exact equivalence, conformance and complete-command performance evidence, rather than a new audit of the predecessor theorem.

## Evidence

- Before: repeated scanning for 33,300 nonzero normals. After: 1,320 projective classes and 31,980 avoided repeated root scans. Every original cofactor and generating-root annihilation check remains.
- Normal and optimized conformance pass in **14.18 s / 14.74 s**. Both registered checks pass, total **28.51 s**, against 120-second per-command limits.
- Exact rational-key comparison covers 624 vectors, 272 classes and 6,864 nonzero field scalings. Four complete flat dictionaries preserve every mask, first normal and insertion position.
- Complete historical stdout is byte-identical, preserving all 5,280 representative support witnesses and eight inherited corruption rejections. Eight new malformed-input, capacity, collision and source-change rejections pass.
- Committed-byte/mode/source-history preflight passes for ten files at `4fdb25a3759fcb86cc92642d97a2a206771a8dfb`.
- Official export integrity and declared-input coverage pass. Optimized Git-free replay passes with empty PATH and read-only exported files. All eleven exported files retain their hashes and modes.

Timing uses CPython 3.12.15 on macOS 27.0.1 arm64. Baseline range is 2.438–2.559 s; accelerated range is 1.329–1.410 s. Each complete fresh-process command uses the same interpreter and `-I -W error -B`; the accelerated side also pays source authentication. Every pair improves. The complete profile identifies repeated root scans as the limiter. A preliminary run overlapping conformance was discarded. Raw samples, reproduction and measurement limits are in the README.

## Reproduction

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/h4-projective-normal-cache/replay.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/h4-projective-normal-cache/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/h4-projective-normal-cache/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h4-projective-normal-cache
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h4-projective-normal-cache --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/h4-projective-normal-cache/benchmark.py --pairs 5
```

Another CPython 3.12 installation may replace this interpreter path. Verification and benchmarking write generated receipts to stdout. No dependency installation or solver is needed.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is an opt-in accelerator for one exact pinned verifier. It does not change the default predecessor command. Performance is a single-host measurement; CI has no timing threshold. The cache is invocation-local and rejects changed source bytes.

Native/caller/ownership/precision/compiler/outer admission and a complete multiplication theorem are outside scope. The selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The five selected framework assumptions remain.

## Open next questions

Can exact cofactor construction be shortened after scan reuse? Profile the complete accelerated command and compare an exact algebraic replacement while preserving every normal and witness output. No such replacement is included; this contribution stops at its first measured improvement.

## Related open work

- [PR6207](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6207) accelerates a fixed 64-axis Clifford projection through quadratic Gauss elimination. Its consumer and timing fixture differ from this H4 root scan.
- [PR6203](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6203) accelerates the nine-screen affine/vector replay through incremental polynomial-code rows. It does not change H4 normal enumeration.
- [PR6204](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6204) reuses an offline export archive index. Its declaration-checking workload differs from this scientific replay.
- [PR6199](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6199) removes a duplicate catalogue read during research-draft creation. It changes a separate command and source-binding path.

The completion refresh examined all eleven other account PRs still open and created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this H4 projective-normal reuse or reports a competing value for the complete H4 timing fixture. No extra computations were run to check another contribution. PR1867 is the merged mathematical and implementation predecessor; unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain outside this bounded overlap check.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/h4-projective-normal-cache)`, passed at exact head `4fdb25a3759fcb86cc92642d97a2a206771a8dfb` in [run 40913777827](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40913777827). The completed checks were read once, and the run's successful conclusion and exact head were confirmed. Local registered replay, committed-source preflight and read-only Git-free export checks also passed. Hosted conformance does not certify the local performance percentage or independent scientific acceptance.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: scoped. The new package is opt-in and leaves the authenticated predecessor source unchanged.
